hypothesis: Charging for required command corrections may improve the policy beyond the identical planner/filter baseline.
novelty_scope: Attributed action-adjustment reward experiment with an ATC-specific normalization; no claim of a new general algorithm or formal safety guarantee.

validation.required: Equal scenario specifications, decision-boundary observations/actions/traffic states and all nine scored metrics; nonzero feedback; original scoring info retained.

training.penalty_applied: Once per live-aircraft decision, including terminal transitions; zero if the filter does not intervene.
training.reward_storage: Returned training reward changes; original total_reward and eight physical scoring metrics remain original.

screen_gate: Expand to 200 development worlds only if arrival is no lower than both same-seed control and classical, clean completion improves by at least 2 percentage points over both, intrusion/restricted/outside means do not increase over either, and mean flight increases by no more than 5% over either. This is a screening rule, not statistical proof or automatic deployment promotion.
selection_scope: Development stream 2026 only. No further use of 2027 or official 42 outcomes for tuning. Fixed primary deployments remain unchanged.
retention: Keep every arm, failed attempt, complete record and adverse outcome. No hyperparameter search in this initial experiment.
